methodology.short: Outer groups use sustained 5 ms RMS silence. Individual cuts use actual low-energy separations where present; continuous triads use repeated consonant-onset spectral changes, with each preceding cut ending before the next consonant begins. No equal subdivision or expected-order-only allocation.
methodology.long: Use full-source Whisper only for group/consonant evidence, then place starts at consonant activity or closure and ends before the following consonant onset. Bounds are not equal subdivisions.
methodology.limits: Automatic transcripts and acoustic boundaries propose cuts; they do not approve pronunciation. Fused sounds and uncertain consonant groups remain held. No timing, pitch, or vowel-length synthesis was applied.
